description: Land Acquisition - Ihala Kotawehera, Uva-Paranagama, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
